messages:
Maria (CSM): Hi team — kicking off VelaHealth onboarding. Goal: live pilot in 30 days. Can we confirm primary stakeholders, success criteria, and any known blockers?
Devon (SE): @Maria I'll own integration touchpoints. Need API keys + sample schema from their data team.
Oliver (AM): I'll coordinate weekly check-ins. Stakeholders: Leah (Vela PM), Marcus (Data Eng), Simone (Security). Confirmed.
Raj (Support): I'll set up SSO docs and VPN notes. Any region constraints? Vela is EU-only for pilot.
Devon (SE): Noted EU region. We'll provision staging in eu-west-1. ETA for keys/schema from Vela: EOD Wed.
Maria (CSM): Success criteria proposal: 1) End-to-end inference with <5% error on core prompts, 2) Stable p95 latency under 800ms on staging, 3) 1-week user feedback loop with 10 testers.
Oliver (AM): +1. Add renewal signal: if pilot meets criteria and 75% usage target, start renewal cadence 2 weeks pre-pilot end.
onboard-bot: Action created: "VelaHealth - staging provisioning" assigned to Devon. Due 1763228000.
Raj (Support): Prep runbook items: SSO steps, cert rotation, contact list. I'll draft and share by tomorrow.
Maria (CSM): Risks: data schema changes mid-pilot, privacy review delay. Mitigations: schema contract + preflight validations, security review slot on Fri.
Devon (SE): Need model profile for cost estimates — what model family are they testing? Vela expects to use a medium LLM variant.
Oliver (AM): I'll push cost/forecast doc after we get expected QPS. Can we collect expected daily queries from Leah?
Maria (CSM): Leah said approx 8k queries/day during pilot — I'll confirm in thread and paste sample later.
Devon (SE): With 8k/day, staging config recommended: 1x dedicated pod (gpu) + autoscale burst to 2. Quantized model OK.
Raj (Support): If we need private deployment later, flag for infra lead. For pilot, hosted dedicated is fine with EU data residency.
Oliver (AM): Weekly milestones: Week 0 (this week) onboarding + creds, Week 1 integration + smoke tests, Week 2 pilot kickoff, Week 3 feedback collection, Week 4 pilot close + renewal decision.
Maria (CSM): Can everyone ack and add any missing owners? I'll compile a 30-day checklist and send calendar invites.
Devon (SE): Ack. I'll add API schema PR and sample curl examples.
Raj (Support): Ack. I'll add runbook draft link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vela-onboard
Oliver (AM): Ack. I'll schedule stakeholder intro on Tue 10am PT.
Maria (CSM): Thanks all :tada: — next steps: I'll post checklist here in an hour and tag Leah for samples.
Leah (Vela PM): (joined) Thanks team — I'll share schema + sample data by end of day. Excited to get started!
